node.title: Rank-eleven active-clone locator shortening adapter
node.closure: the active large-clone horn is reversibly converted to a mass-preserving shortened 2 x 4 factor bucket
node.statement: In the active large-clone output of the base-free KoalaBear rank-eleven 2 x 5 factor branch, the common evaluation kernel B_D has dimension four and is divisible by the squarefree locator of the clone. Division transports the complete first-owned mass at least 388650911452 to a shortened 2 x 4 factor bucket with parameters (n-c,k-c,m-c), preserving slopes, pair noncontainment, and all three row differences. The polynomial product dimension bound dim(P bar(B)_D)>=5 forces 10001<=c<=K-5=1048571. The shortened bucket and the genuine rank-two alternative remain unpaid.
